{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge turtleneck: slim fit, hip length, long sleeves, dusty blue #8fa3b8, extra-fine merino wool
Trousers: straight cut, high waist, full length reaching the top of the boot, charcoal #3b3f48, wool-blend flannel
Coat: single-breasted, tailored fit, below the knee, deep navy #22304a, wool-cashmere with a lined interior
Thick socks: mid-calf, heather grey #7a7f88, merino wool blend
Ankle boots: round toe, low block heel, grippy rubber sole, black #1c1a1d, waterproof-treated leather with a warm lining
Scarf: wide and generously long, light blue-grey #b9c4d0, soft wool
Gloves: classic cut, wrist length, black #1c1a1d, leather with a cashmere lining
Hat: close-fitting beanie with a folded cuff, charcoal #4a4d55, wool-cashmere knit
Bag: structured tote, fits the shoulder over the coat, black #1c1a1d, grained leather

This outfit keeps a classic, understated office look while staying properly warm for a 20-minute walk in deep frost and snow. The knit and flannel trousers are neat enough for work, and the long wool-cashmere coat blocks the wind. The boots have a grippy sole for snow and treated leather that handles road salt, and the scarf, gloves and hat protect the areas that get coldest. The dusty blue and soft grey-blue sit gently against your fair skin and blue-grey eyes, while the navy, charcoal and black keep everything calm and cohesive."}
